items:
Brand new 30A rental house! Just a quick 0.6 mile golf cart ride to world famous 30A beaches!

8 Bedrooms (each with full private bathroom) and 3 living rooms, with Roku smart tv’s in each room!

Designer grade furnishings and spacious layout for the ultimate 30A family vacation!

Private pool with pool side seating (Seasonally heated from October 1 through April 30)

Includes free 2025 six seater golf cart and two inflatable paddle boards!

Welcome to Harmony, the ultimate 30A experience. Newly constructed in 2025, this spacious house comfortably sleeps 18 guests, and is located conveniently on the west side of famous 30-A! That means enjoying all that 30A has to offer, without being stuck in the middle of summer traffic!

Enjoy a short golf cart ride to the multiple beach accesses located along famous 30-A!

With eight bedrooms (each with its own private bathroom) and three living room areas, your family will have plenty of space to comfortably relax after a long day of fun in the sun! Plus, enjoy relaxing sunrises and sunsets on Harmony’s beautiful 4th floor deck and top floor observation deck, where you can soak in wonderful gulf views!

Gulf views, private pool, and an included electric six seater golf cart?? Everything you need to create the ultimate vacation memories!

Highlights:
Just 0.6 miles from the closest beach access
Roku Smart TVs in every bedroom and living room!
Sleeps 18!
8 bedrooms, each with full private bathrooms!
Private backyard pool (heated for free from October 1 to April 30)
3 separate living rooms for multiple families
Free 6 seat golf cart
Two free paddleboards

Harmony offers the perfect location for relaxing along famous Highway 30-A. Or, travel just 9 miles to Seaside for plenty of family fun and great local restaurants! At the end of a sun packed day, cool off in Harmony’s private pool area (seasonally heated from October 1 - April 30).

Save a trip to the car wash and zip around in style with the included 6 seater golf cart! No need to cover your car’s floorboards in sand. Load up the golf cart with coolers and beach toys, and visit one of the many beach accesses easily available along 30A!

This isn’t just a cookie cutter rental. Harmony was decorated by professional interior designers, making you feel right at home from the minute you enter!

Need some adult conversation or separate living spaces for multiple families? Harmony has three separate living spaces (each with its own 65”, high definition, smart TV) to give you plenty of options for elbow room!

No need to drain your wallet on toy rentals. Harmony includes 2 paddleboards, and a brand new 6 seater golf cart to help make lifelong memories.

And when you are ready to return home, cool off in our pool or lounge on its splash deck. Afterward, grill your fresh caught seafood in the free-to-use propane grill.

After enjoying the beautiful sugar sand beaches, take a ride in the golf cart to all of the nearby restaurants, shopping, and more for the proper 30-A experience!

Book Harmony now! This new to market listing is sure to book up fast!

Save for Later
Don’t forget to click the “Save” button to make it easier to find this property later! (Click the “Heart” symbol in the upper right hand corner of your mobile device display or click the “Save” link at the top of the listing.)

Harmony Bed, Bath and Sleeping Layout

First Floor:
Parking for up to 6 midsized vehicles; stairway to enter house
Other: Private pool area/grill area

Second Floor (first interior floor):
Bedroom 1: King with private bath (sleeps 2)
Bedroom 2: Twin over King bunk with private bath (sleeps 2)
Other: Kitchen/Living/Dining/Laundry

Third Floor (second interior floor):
Bedroom 3: Twin over King bunk with private bath (sleeps 2)
Bedroom 4: King with private bath (sleeps 2)
Bedroom 5: King with private bath (sleeps 2)
Bedroom 6: King with private bath (sleeps 2)
Other: Living Room with 2nd Floor Front Balcony Access

Fourth Floor (third interior floor):
Bedroom 7: King with private bath (sleeps 2)
Bedroom 8: King with private bath (sleeps 2)
Other: Living Room with 4th Floor Front Balcony Access, and spiral staircase to rooftop viewing deck

-----------------------------------------------------------
Parking:
Harmony has parking for up to 6 mid size cars.

-----------------------------------------------------------
Pool Size:
Harmony has a pool that is 12 feet wide, 28 feet long, and a depth of 3 feet in the shallow end and 5 feet deep end. Heated between October 1 and April 30 at no additional charge. Not heated between May and September.

-----------------------------------------------------------
Important Information:

NOTE: Check in time is 4:00 PM CST. Check out time is 10:00 AM CST. Our staff needs time to properly clean, sanitize, inspect and maintain the property. Because the property is extremely heavily booked we are unable to offer early check ins, late check outs, early parking or luggage drop offs.

NOTE: Guests are not permitted to have anything shipped or mailed (through a carrier such as USPS, UPS, or Fedex) to the property. Please be aware that the property does not have postal service and your packages will most likely be returned by the carrier.

NOTE: Guests are not permitted to have local deliveries (such as baby gear, beach chairs/gear, groceries, golf carts) made prior to their check-in time of 4:00 PM CST and are not permitted to have local pick-ups made after their check-out time of 10:00 AM CST.

NOTE: If you would like to reserve Harmony more than 11 months in advance, you must use the VRBO website, rather than the VRBO app. The VRBO app only shows the calendar for up to 11 months which means that it can only be used for reservations less than a year away. Thanks!

NOTE: This property is available for vacation rental only. Parties are prohibited.

NOTE: AGE REQUIREMENTS. You must be at least 25 years old to reserve Harmony during Spring Break. Sorry, there are no exceptions.

NOTE: Sorry, no pets. No emotional support animals (ESA). No exceptions. Many of our Guests have pet allergies and rely on us to provide a pet free environment. Bringing a pet or an emotional support animal (ESA) is a violation of your booking agreement that will result in the cancellation of your reservation without refund.

NOTE: Harmony has one security camera aimed solely at the driveway and the street entrance. Our security camera can only see areas of the property that are visible to the public anyway. We respect our Guests’ privacy. The camera is stationary and cannot be remotely adjusted; does not record audio; and cannot see into the pool area, fenced areas, or interior area of the property.

NOTE: For the safety of our Guests, our golf cart has an Apple Airtag in order to facilitate our ability to assist in the event of an accident or mechanical failure. As a result, Apple Iphone users may occasionally receive Airtag notifications while operating the golf cart.

NOTE: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the house. This includes cigarettes, cigars, marijuana, etc. A $500-1000 additional cleaning charge will be added to remove the smell of smoke from the house.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
